name: philips-hue
description: Connect to Philips Hue through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Signify runs a remote MCP on its meethue.com domain with open dynamic client registration, but no Hue developer or support page documents it yet, so tools and stability are unconfirmed; the documented routes are the local Bridge API and the Remote Hue API (free developer account). Community servers exist (e.g. github.com/m2ai-mcp-servers/mcp-philips-hue). Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256, token endpoint auth none.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
